question: what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_totals AS (SELECT Donor, SUM(Amount) AS total_amount FROM donations GROUP BY Donor), repeat_donors AS (SELECT Donor FROM donations GROUP BY Donor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN Donor IN (SELECT Donor FROM repeat_donors) THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Amount), 0) AS percent_of_total_from_repeat_donors, COUNT(DISTINCT Donor) AS number_of_repeat_donors FROM donations

CURRENT QUESTION:
what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH donor_totals AS (
    SELECT Donor, SUM(Amount) AS total_amount
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY Donor
),
repeat_donors AS (
    SELECT Donor
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY Donor
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Donor IN (SELECT Donor FROM repeat_donors) THEN Amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / SUM(Amount) AS percent_of_total_from_repeat_donors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Donor) AS number_of_repeat_donors
FROM donations;
```
